top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a single, mature achievement: the physiology of GLP-1 (Holst on the incretin effect and secretion, Mojsov on the identity of the active peptide, Drucker on receptor action and proglucagon biology). It produced a discernible change in the field, a targetable molecule and receptor, and its clinical consequences are confirmed in large independent randomized trials. The allocation to three laureates and the citation scope are well bounded, so awarding is clearly preferable to no award.
